project_name: Rainy Night Melodies - Silent AI Hook
mission_statement: Create a series of 4 highly consistent, high-fidelity visual prompts for a 1-minute silent playlist intro. Focus on cinematic quality and 'Masterpiece' aesthetics.

production_protocol.step_1_contextual_grounding: Analyze the emotional core: Solitude, warmth, nighttime, rain, high-art noir.

step_2_visual_consistency_locking.art_style: 19th-century Oil Painting (Impressionist influence), visible brushstrokes, high-end digital polish.
step_2_visual_consistency_locking.lighting_schema: Dual-tone contrast: Cyan streetlights vs. Warm Amber interior lamp light.
step_2_visual_consistency_locking.character_profile: Lonesome traveler, 30s, vintage brown wool coat, melancholic but serene expression.

production_protocol.step_3_prompt_generation: Generate 4 distinct prompts. Each prompt must start with: 'An oil painting masterpiece in the style of [Master Style Guide], showing...'. Ensure the character identity details are repeated EXACTLY in each prompt to lock identity.

scene_storyboard.description: The traveler looking out of a rain-streaked window at a blurred neon city.
Extreme closeup of a steaming coffee cup next to an old, weathered book on a mahogany table.
A wide shot from inside the cafe, showing the silhouette of the traveler and blurred figures passing by outside in the rain.
The traveler closing their eyes and tilting their head slightly, reflecting the warm amber light of the cafe.

output_format: JSON array of image prompts optimized for DALL-E 3 or Midjourney v7.
